like.description: The hardened image to replace (its name gives the kind and the .NET version).

registryPrefix.description: What goes in front of a repository name in an image reference (default ${REGISTRY_PREFIX}).

registryToken.description: Password / token; sent as Bearer when there is no user (default ${REGISTRY_TOKEN}).

localImages.description: Also consider the images `docker image ls` reports (default true).

source.description: The Dockerfile, or the project folder that contains it.

service.description: The compose service whose image this replaces. Default: matched by name.

baseImage.description: The unhardened base image to build on. Default: the best candidate.

context.description: Build context. Default: worked out from the project paths the Dockerfile copies.

composeFile.description: Compose file that defines the service (default ${COMPOSE_FILE}).

tag.description: The debug image, repo:tag. Default: the service's image repo with tag ${VERSION}-debug (without VERSION: the tag the service has now, plus -debug).

asRoot.description: Run as root in the debug image (default true).

packages.description: Install ps, curl and unzip with the base image's package manager (default true).

configuration.description: Build configuration that replaces Release (default Debug; empty = leave as is).

vsdbg.description: How the debugger gets in. mount (default): bind-mount the vsdbg folder at /remote_debugger when the service starts, as Visual Studio does. copy: bake that folder into the image. download: run GetVsDbg.sh at build time (needs internet).

vsdbgDir.description: Folder that holds vsdbg (default ${VSDBG_DIR}, then %USERPROFILE%/vsdbg/vs2017u5, where Visual Studio keeps it). Its linux-musl-x64 subfolder is used for an alpine base.

vsdbgUrl.description: For vsdbg=download: the GetVsDbg.sh script (default ${VSDBG_URL}, then https://aka.ms/getvsdbgsh).

vsdbgMount.description: Host folder to bind-mount at /remote_debugger (default ${DEBUG_VSDBG_MOUNT}; none = vsdbg is in the image).

sourceInContainer.description: Where the sources were during the build (default ${DEBUG_SOURCE_ROOT}).

sourceOnDisk.description: The same sources on this machine (default ${DEBUG_CONTEXT}).

launchJson.description: Where to write the launch file (on this machine).
